text:
anas (new-hire): hey team! onboarding day 3. ran into a few quick obs snags: 1) Grafana dashboard panels show "No data" when I use the 'last 30m' time range even though Datadog metrics show values. 2) Trying to open a Sentry issue alert but I get "project not found". 3) Datadog APM traces tab is completely empty for my service. where do I start?
tara (observability): welcome :tada: For (1) check the datasource on the grafana panel - it should be "Datadog Metrics" (our named datasource is "dd-metrics-prod"). if a panel uses a different datasource or an alias from your org view, you can see No data even if metrics exist. also confirm the query uses the correct metric name and tags.
anas (new-hire): how do I check datasource? I only see the dashboard UI.
tara (observability): Dashboard -> Settings (cog) -> Panels -> click the panel -> Query -> check datasource in the top-left of the panel editor. If you don't see the cog, you might not have edit permissions.
anas (new-hire): I can't access Dashboard -> Settings, I get a permission denied modal.
mike (infra): that means you're not in the folder ACL for that dashboard. quick fixes: 1) Export the panel JSON and import into a personal folder (works for a local copy), or 2) request folder edit by filing an access request. we usually add folks to the "dash-editors" group for learning.
anas (new-hire): filed access request via internal portal: Datadog/Grafana -> "Grafana - Dashboard edit". request ID #4627.
tara (observability): for (2) Sentry -> "project not found" usually means your account isn't a member of the project team or the project slug was renamed. check the Sentry web UI top-left org selector and make sure you're in the right org. if the project is missing, ping @mike for infra sync.
anas (new-hire): I do see the org but not the project in the dropdown. I'll add that note to the access request.
mike (infra): for (3) APM: Datadog traces require both the Datadog APM role and that the service is sending traces to the environment you're looking at. two things to try: a) confirm the service name in the tracing config matches what Datadog expects (search for service:my-service in dd-agent logs), b) request 'datadog-apm-read' role if you can't see traces even though they are listed in our agent.
tara (observability): also note: our Datadog project splits prod/preprod by tags. Use the timeframe filter and set the correct tag filter: env:prod or env:staging. often new hires forget tag filters and think traces vanished.
devex-bot: Access request #4627 created for anas (new-hire) - Grafana Dashboard edit. ETA 1 business day. If urgent, escalate to #eng-oncall.
anas (new-hire): thanks all. one more thing: is there a single doc that lists which roles map to which UI permissions across Grafana/Datadog/Sentry? couldn't find it in the handbook.
tara (observability): good call. short answer: no single canonical doc yet. long term: we want a matrix in the dev handbook. for now, see: https://redwood.company/internal/obs-access-matrix (temporary) and ping observability if anything missing.
mike (infra): adding a note: if you need bulk access for a sprint, request a service account for dashboards (Grafana service account) - that's reviewed by infra and requires an owner.
anas (new-hire): got it. filing the Sentry and Datadog APM bits too. really appreciate the quick help :pray:
tara (observability): welcome aboard! drop a link to your onboarding runbook if you want a quick pass on dashboards to include.
anas (new-hire): will do :smile:
